_comment: Zone-level Cache Rule for poki2.online. Cloudflare Pages classifies text/html as dynamic and ignores the s-maxage in public/_headers until the edge is explicitly authorised to cache it. This file is the source of truth for that rule; it is applied out-of-band (dashboard or API), not by the Pages deploy.
_apply: PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/<ZONE_ID>/rulesets/phases/http_request_cache_settings/entrypoint with this file's 'rules' array as the body. Requires an API token with Zone.Cache Rules:Edit. Substitute your own zone id and ruleset id -- they are deliberately not committed here, because they identify one person's Cloudflare account.
_zone_id: Set $CF_ZONE_ID or write the zone id to ~/.poki2-cf-zone (0600, outside this repo).
_ruleset_id: The ruleset id changes on every edit; read it back from the ruleset endpoint after each change rather than hardcoding it here.
_why_host_only: The expression matches host only, deliberately. Path-level divergence (HTML vs immutable assets) is already handled by public/_headers, and a path list is one more thing that can silently fail to match. An earlier attempt that enumerated /blog/*, /fgame/* etc. was never verified to fire.
_why_respect_origin: edge_ttl respects the origin header rather than overriding it, so HTML keeps its 3600s s-maxage while CSS/JS/images keep their own max-age=31536000, immutable. An override would have silently shortened the asset cache from one year to the override value.
_verified: 2026-11-03 22:15 GMT+8: GET / -> MISS, MISS, HIT (age 4), HIT (age 10). /about, /blog/best-2-player-browser-games, /fgame/2048 -> MISS then HIT. /css/style.css still `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`.
_purge_required: HTML is now edge-cached for up to 3600s plus stale-while-revalidate=86400. scripts/purge-cache.js clears the zone after each deploy; it needs an API token with Zone.Cache Purge.

rules.description: Edge-cache HTML for poki2.online (Pages treats text/html as dynamic)
